name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 15 – Am 16/1
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 15b. Calls on the Commission to introduce European preventive mechanisms to make access to EU funds conditional on prior checks on the absence of connections to organised crime, extending this approach to all public and private entities that are beneficiaries of EU-financed contracts, concessions and contributions; calls for these mechanisms to be incorporated into the Rule of Law Conditionality Regulation and the Common Provisions Regulation so that protecting EU funds from infiltration by criminal organisations becomes a systematic cross-cutting requirement;
